title: Qualification evidence
summary: WebSocket dev1 remains the immutable qualified release. The current dev4 source candidate adds fragmentation/close repairs, estate crypto integration, server-side RFC6455 access and an owned-HTTPS upgrade seam, but none of those later increments are promoted until fresh r13196/dev16/COTS/HTTPS execution completes.
invariants: dev1 contract evidence includes the RFC 6455 example handshake accept calculation and masking vector.
dev1 live COTS evidence used an independent Python websockets server through SocketProvider isolation.
SocketAddress identity survives the isolation seam as an object.

dev4 contract fixtures cover fragmented messages, interleaved control frames, close-frame transmission, parsed HTTPS handoff, coalesced first-frame preservation, client masking, Origin admission and WebSocket version rejection.
dev4 optional crypto fixture covers RFC6455 SHA-1 accept calculation and base64 through crypto.auth/0.1 with injected deterministic entropy.
No dev4 PASS is claimed until these tests execute under ooRexx 5.3.0 r13196 against Socket Provider dev16.
No owned-HTTPS/wss PASS is claimed until the HTTPS component supplies its upgrade-stream wrapper and a live TLS upgrade is exercised.
Independent review remains requested on Rasen Falcon lane websocket-access as REQ-00000381; HTTPS counterpart work is requested as REQ-00001851.

provenance.claim: Records dev4 SOURCE_CANDIDATE status and exact promotion gates.
Server/HTTPS handoff contract fixture; source present, not locally executed.
